details:
1. Run the game and enable OSC in its settings.

2. Open the camera UI (through the radial Tools menu or the mini pause screen).

3. Switch to stream mode and enable Spout output.

    --The Spout stream should be visible in other apps (e.g. OBS).

4. Send a '/usercamera' OSC command (Pose, Capture, etc.) - this will work and change camera state.

5. Close the camera UI.

    --The Spout stream will still be visible in other apps even though it is not visible in-game.

6. Send the same '/usercamera' OSC command - this will NOT work.

    --I can still see my camera feed while it is in Spout stream mode, but I cannot control it.

I run cameras for a small virtual event, capturing both my first-person perspective and a camera feed, but despite being able to build a camera control app outside the game now, the need to have the camera UI open to control it makes this *very* difficult (especially as a desktop user) and effectively limits me to only using it for "extra pins".

I do not consider the feature functional in its current state.
title: Camera OSC does not work unless Camera UI is open.
